title: ST2110-20: add dissector for SMPTE ST2110-20
description:
Add basic support for ST2110-20 decoding
This patch doesn't use SDP metadata

Signed-off-by: Sergey V. Lobanov <sergey@lobanov.in>

Remark: it is possible to generate ST2110 streams using gstreamer: https://github.com/pkeroulas/st2110-toolkit/blob/master/doc/SW_source.md

pcap samples: https://github.com/NEOAdvancedTechnology/ST2110_pcap_zoo
